images.title: Plan of a group investigation
images.purpose: Shows the four steps of the group sleep project: question, collect, summarise, show.
images.composition: Four large rounded boxes in one row joined by arrows, each with a simple icon or one short piece of data inside. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Four equal rounded rectangles in a single row, evenly spaced, joined by three grey right pointing arrows. Each box has its title above it. Box 1, title 'Question', teal (#0072B2) border, holds one large '?'. Box 2, title 'Collect', teal border, holds the data '9, 8.5, 10, 9'. Box 3, title 'Summarise', amber (#E69F00) border, holds two lines: 'mean 9.125' and 'median 9'. Box 4, title 'Show', reddish purple (#CC79A7) border, holds a tiny plain bar chart of 4 bars with no text. Exactly 4 boxes, 3 arrows.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A project moves in four steps: ask, collect, summarise with mean and median, then show.
images.description: Shows the four steps of the group sleep project: question, collect, summarise, show.
images.context: Four children sleep 9, 8.5, 10, 9 hours: mean 36.5 ÷ 4 = 9.125, median 9.

image_decisions.why: A project concept is a plan; a four step diagram gives the group a clear path.
